title: Generative AI & Data Science Fellowship
summary: This one-year fellowship, offered in collaboration with the MIT Institute for Data, Systems, and Society (IDSS), equips professionals with the critical knowledge and practical skills to lead in data science and generative AI.
eligibility: Professional resume and undergraduate transcript are required for all applicants. For international candidates, proof of English proficiency and NACES evaluation may be required.

title: IndiaAI Fellowship 2026–2027
summary: The IndiaAI Fellowship 2026–2027 offers financial support to eligible students pursuing AI-related research, with additional funding available for eligible international conference presentations.

title: Summer Fellowship (US)
summary: The Institute for Law & AI’s Summer Fellowship (US) is a paid program that offers law students, professionals, and academics the opportunity to participate at the leading edge of AI law and policy, with a particular focus on United States Law and Policy.

title: CNS Advanced Summer Research Fellowship
summary: The CNS Advanced Summer Research Fellowship provides financial support to undergraduate students in the College of Natural Sciences who are conducting an advanced summer research project under the supervision of a UT faculty member.
organization: University of Texas at Austin College of Natural Sciences
deadlineEvidence: Fellowship application deadline: Friday, February 19, 2027 at 11:59 PM
eligibility:
Must be a full-time, degree-seeking CNS undergraduate student
* Must graduate in Summer 2027 or later
* Home institution must be UT Austin
* Must have completed a qualifying prior research experience
* Must have a confirmed summer research project and UT faculty research supervisor
